description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md and discovers memory_search with the proprietary `role` parameter. It MUST call memory_search with role='user' and a short, focused query like 'PCR protocol' to find user-spoken memory chunks — generic agents will omit the role filter and only get low-quality assistant-role results with no task_id. 2. The search returns chunks with task_id='task_pcr_brca1_2024'. Agent then calls task_summary(taskId='task_pcr_brca1_2024') to get the full protocol narrative. 3. Agent calls skill_get(taskId='task_pcr_brca1_2024') or skill_get(skillId='skill_pcr_protocol_v2') to retrieve the experience guide. 4. Agent calls skill_install(skillId='skill_pcr_protocol_v2') BEFORE calling skill_publish(skillId='skill_pcr_protocol_v2') — install must precede publish per the decision flow. 5. Agent calls memory_write_public(content='...BRCA1 PCR protocol details...', summary='...') with meaningful protocol content and a non-empty summary field. 6. Agent creates handoff_report.json containing task_id='task_pcr_brca1_2024', skill_id='skill_pcr_protocol_v2', and a protocol_summary field with PCR-specific content. The key proprietary traps: (a) role='user' filter in memory_search — without this, search returns incomplete results without task_id; (b) minScore must not be set below the 0.35 floor; (c) skill_install must precede skill_publish in the correct workflow order.
